setup_multimodal_pretraining_task: setup a MultimodalPretrainingTask with audio, image, and text pretraining configurations
load_multimodal_dataset: load a multimodal dataset for a given split combining audio, image, and text modalities
get_multimodal_batch_iterator: get a GroupedEpochBatchIterator for multimodal data with modality-specific sampling ratios
configure_multimodal_pretraining: configure MultimodalPretrainingConfig with audio, image, and text ratio settings for fairseq
review_supported_modalities: review the supported_modalities property to check which modalities are enabled in the task config
